rationale: Price is at 98.6% of today's range and within $0.03 of the session high, offering an extremely unfavorable risk/reward for a long entry — the stop would need to be wide relative to any remaining upside. A short against the trend of a stock that gapped up and has been grinding higher all session into a broad market selloff carries its own risk, as TIGO is showing relative strength that could persist. With SPY down 1.83% and VIXY up 8.19%, the macro environment is hostile to new risk-on positions, and the thin remaining upside at the high of range does not justify committing capital in either direction.
